notes: Rule 11: «وذكر، لها أن عبد الله بن عمر، يقول إن الميت ليعذب» quotes Ibn Umar inside Aisha's story. Not added as a link; whether he is the last link is for a ruling.
«أخبرته» is the verb of Amra's telling; its pronoun points to the previous link and adds no name.
«أبيه» names the father of Abdullah b. Abi Bakr only by relation.
